blockers.message: E2 exit gate is not_met: No missed vulnerability from the independent population was shown to be recovered. The dataflow and IR work was measured on fixtures; the baseline run already contains it, so its effect on real code has no before measurement. 272 of 278 scored entries are still missed.
U-01: E2 exit gate not met: no missed real-code vulnerability shown recovered
U-02: Publish-time checks were not run: dependency currency and hosted CI
U-03: No version bump or changelog entry for this work
U-04: Branch merge was not authorised and nothing was pushed

caveats: E3 exit gate partially met: One declared gap still accepts an unsafe fix (1 of 15) and 3 of 8 safe fixes are refused; both are listed in the benchmark.
E4 exit gate partially met: Measurable and proof-backed, but the cases are synthetic and author-labelled, two safe routes become false positives, and Flask is mostly unresolved.

E6 exit gate partially met: Scans are bounded and containment is measured, but the measured benefit (1.72 times for one changed file) is under the 2 times aspiration and the 829-file class never completes its deep analysis.
